retained_rows.assessment_basis: The unwanted access/service behaviour directly engages the OECD repair proposition. Business Insider and TechRadar preserve a fix and normal success rates after the bounded April 7 outage; their different duration descriptions do not negate the observed recovery. This affirmatively supports repair in the reported restoration stage, bounded to the disclosed affected scope. It does not establish prevention of recurrence, full internal controls or every individual user outcome.
retained_rows.identification_basis: The preserved service-restoration evidence directly identifies the OECD appropriate repair proposition independently of a taxonomy-derived candidate.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: Claude.ai and Code suffered a major outage while API and Cowork remained operational. Loss of the operational GAI use context makes stakeholder communication planning relevant. Public status updates are affirmative communication evidence, but the record does not supply the maintained plan, context-specific contact provisions and full workaround/alternative-process coverage required by MG-2.4-001. The planning outcome remains unresolved without using voluntary adoption as a gate.
